marco: Quick question for the marketplace teamWe're prepping a single Private SKU for AWS/GCP/Azure. Do we support BYOK in the listing or make BYOK an enterprise-only flow? Need a recommendation so product can finalize packaging.

rachel: Partnerships POV: support BYOK as an option in the listing. Many enterprise buyers filter on BYOK. Offer two provisioning paths in the manifest: `rdw-managed` and `customer-byok`. Keep the default as rdw-managed to simplify trials.

paul: Ops: agree with optional BYOK. We'll publish small ops snippets for each cloud (AWS KMS policy, GCP IAM binding, Azure Key Vault policy). For marketplace trials, enforce rdw-managed only to avoid key provisioning delays.

nina: Legal: BYOK adds complexity (warranty/notice on key compromise). We can support it; legal will add a short clause and a responsibility matrix.

devops-bot: Created ticket MKP-1122: `private-sku-byo-option-and-ops-snippets` assigned to ops/product/legal. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKP-1122

marco: Actionables: Paul to draft ops snippets by Thu EOD; Rachel to update manifest schema (add kms_support) and sample manifest; Nina to draft BYOK clause. Quick sync Fri 9:00 PT to sign off. Thanks! :thumbsup:
